atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m11_chirp'>Could you please sign this book for me?</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f13_chirp'>Can you paint me a portrait of my husband?</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f9_chirp'>I would like to report a fire on Morton Road!</voice>

atoms.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_chirp'>I would like to report a robbery at The Golden Pot restaurant on Camberwell Terrace.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m7_chirp'>My computer isn’t working anymore. Could you repair it for me?</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f4_chirp'>Yes, there’s a leak under the sink there. I think a pipe’s broken — Can you fix it?</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m13_chirp'>I have a legal problem that I need help with.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m1_chirp'>I would like to borrow all these books!</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f6_chirp'>Hello, my car isn’t working anymore. Can you send someone to help me?</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m9_chirp'>Thank you, could I have a cup of tea to go with it?</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m12_chirp'>Can you schedule my meeting with James for Tuesday afternoon?</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m10_chirp'>I have a very bad headache and can’t sleep well.</voice>
